description: Planlagte trafikanlæg - PlanDK is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. Planning Act § 11a, 4 Traffic facilities "location of traffic facilities". See the Planning Act:. Coverage: Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "Planned traffic facilities - PlanDK" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. Its keywords include Planlægning, Kommuneplanlægning. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PNG, GML. The listing shows 2025-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
